import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import type { Config, Options as Opts } from "./config";
import * as path from "node:path";
import Default, * as NS from "./ns";
export type * as Types from "./types";
export * from "./all";

/**
 * A user of the store.
 * @param {string} name the display name
 * @returns {Promise<User[]>} every user
 * @typedef {object} Point
 * @see {@link Store}
 */
export interface User {
  id: number;
  name?: string;
  readonly tags: string[];
  cb: () => void;
  new (x: number): User;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

export class Store<T extends User> implements Iterable<T>, Disposable {
  private items = new Map<number, T>();
  static readonly MAX_ITEMS = 100;
  constructor(private readonly config: Config, public name?: string) {}

  add(item: T): void {
    this.items.set(item.id, item);
  }

  async load(path: string): Promise<T[]> {
    const raw = await readFile(path, "utf8");
    return JSON.parse(raw) as T[];
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.items.size;
  }

  *[Symbol.iterator](): Iterator<T> {
    yield* this.items.values();
  }

  default() {
    return this.items;
  }

  make<K extends keyof T>(base: T, key: K): T[K] {
    return base[key];
  }
}
